title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, NFTs, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: SEC interpretation on crypto laws ‘a beginning, not an end,‘ says Atkins
summary: The SEC chair signaled that the agency would defer to a market structure bill if passed by Congress, but needed a ”bridge” to clarify crypto regulation.

title: BPI sounds alarm on 'backdoor' for hardware wallets in Kentucky crypto bill
summary: Provisions in the state legislation violate the core ethos and value proposition of Bitcoin as an asset that can be held in self-custody, the trade group said.

title: SOL treasury Forward industries buys back shares using crypto-backed debt
summary: The company is leveraging its crypto treasury to fund a share buyback, reducing outstanding shares and potentially boosting per-share value following a six-month slide.

title: EtherFi turns to real-world assets for yield with $25M Plume allocation
summary: EtherFi will integrate Plume’s Nest vaults, beginning with exposure to a Superstate-backed fund and expanding to a dedicated RWA vault within its platform.

title: Bybit launches yield-bearing tokenized gold, expanding RWA yield market
summary: The crypto exchange is offering a yield product tied to Tether Gold (XAUT), signaling a shift toward turning traditionally passive assets like gold into income-generating instruments.

title: Animoca invests in Ava Labs to boost Avalanche adoption in Asia, Middle East
summary: The Web3 company will provide capital, advisory support and business development to help Avalanche projects scale, with a focus on real-world assets and digital identity.

title: Bitcoin bull market vibes emerge, but confirmation is missing: Glassnode
summary: Bitcoin markets have started to turn bullish again, but data shows that a key “bull market threshold” has not been established yet.

title: Singapore-based Ryde adopts crypto treasury strategy
summary: The carpool and ride-sharing platform, which already accepted Bitcoin for customer payment, moves to crypto treasury despite challenges of price declines.

title: Bitcoin drops 10% to threaten new retest of 'unreliable' BTC price support
summary: Bitcoin brought its latest correction from local highs to near 10% as skepticism over long-term BTC price support grew louder.
